column1: # The layer registry is the design-review boundary for every workspace crate.
# means that the crate currently admits no first-party dependency layer.
# The closed claim lattice is a foundational pure value/type gate; it owns no
# cryptographic construction or evidence storage and has no first-party edges.
# Amendment: codec's canonical framing computes digests; identity hashes are
# constitutionally owned by fgit-crypto, so codec sits above crypto.
# GoldLotus FG-055 ruling (bead comment 1364): evidence records are
# crypto-identified (L1) and codec-framed (L2) bodies, so this crate is L2.
